description_en: Queries the authorization status of the service-linked role for Web Application Firewall (WAF)
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-role-auth-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-aekzhalsanv000 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRoleAuthStatus

parameters.help_en:
The region in which the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

AuthStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the service-linked role for WAF is authorized.

true: The service-linked role is authorized.

false: The service-linked role is not authorized
AuthStatus.description_zh:
授权状态。
false：未授权。
true：已授权
